heading: Absolute coordinates are folded at compile time
text:
### Absolute coordinates are folded at compile time [LTSL.3.7]

An absolute coordinate must be a `calendar.time` call whose arguments fold
([LTIM.14.3]). The compiler resolves it to `TestCase.when_ns` at **compile** time
([RLOW.17.1]), so the same `.dstest` compiles to the same instant on every host
([LDET.3.2]). The compiler must refuse with `DS_VALIDATE_TEST_BAD_TIMESTAMP` a
coordinate of any other form, one whose fold would raise [LTIM.14.2]'s fault,
and one before 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, which `when_ns` cannot carry.
